note:
staging takes 1.4.1 from 1.4.0. One release, nothing skipped, so no landing
section goes unread. Class fix. Disruption quiet: neither core floor moved
(codex 0.147.0, claude 2.1.227, unchanged since 1.4.0).

The box half, measured on staging at 16:00 UTC on 2026-09-02 before this note
was written. claw-members holds one person. That person's persistent core is
installed and reads 2.1.227, which meets the floor. So no member on this claw
reads as below a floor, and the claw's own classifier will not defer this
release to the quiet window.

Two things this release changes about riding one. The health reading at the
end of an apply is now scripts/unit-health.sh and it has two halves: nothing
failed, and nothing in activating carrying a restart count. An empty
systemctl --failed on its own is no longer the health line. And the wake rail's
per-account unit no longer fails when that account has nobody signed in: it
idles, says so once in the journal, and starts delivering when a session opens.
Before this release that state exited the unit and systemd restarted it
forever, which took a whole apply down on 2026-09-02.

The operator runbook lands at /opt/commonclaw/doc/operator-runbook.md on every
claw that takes this release.
